meta.defaultDescription: Physical NFC products and digital scenarios for businesses in Moldova and Romania. AI consultant, configurator, and Telegram handoff.

home.headline: One stand. One tap. One clear next step.
home.subhead: Physical NFC products paired with digital scenarios — reviews, smart menu, or a short action page — then handed to a manager in Telegram.
home.proof: Physical products and digital solutions designed together — not a tag shop.
home.hookTitle: Guests will not hunt for your review link.
home.insightBody: Put a clear physical object where the decision happens — table, reception, court — and open a single useful digital action. We keep Products (what you hold) separate from Solutions (what the tap does).
home.insightNote: No invented conversion lifts. Standard stand pricing uses approved quantity tiers only.
home.catalogTitle: Stands, plaques, and kits you can configure
home.catalogLead: Example: start with the standard review stand, then customize colour and destination. Custom shapes are individually quoted.
home.catalogNote: Standard stand tiers: 1–2 @ 450 · 3–6 @ 400 · 7–10 @ 350 · 11–19 @ 300 · 20+ @ 250 MDL/unit. Everything else = individual quote.
home.nextProducts: Configure a stand or send the brief to Telegram when you are ready.
home.solutionsLead: The digital job after the tap — distinct from the physical SKU. Same object can drive reviews, menu, or a short page.
home.nfcInsight: Insight: NFC plus a code-generated QR fallback keeps the path reliable when phones differ.
home.nfcBenefit: Benefit: guests act in place — no app install pitch, no invented metrics.
home.demoTitle: Footage from a real NFC interaction
home.demoBody: Example: a live tap on a physical Touchform object. Production materials and destinations are confirmed with the team.
home.casesLead: Cucurigo, Délice d’Ange, and Padel Point — honest summaries; partial notes where live details are still being verified.
home.partialNote: Live details still being verified — no invented metrics.
home.aiTitle: Short discovery. Structured offer. Real chat UI.
home.aiBody: Describe the business and the action you want. The consultant returns ideas and a schema 1.0 concept — then you visualize and hand off in Telegram.
home.leadTitle: Send the idea to a manager
home.leadSub: We reply in Telegram. No cart, no fake checkout.
home.why1Body: We pair the physical product with the customer action you want.
home.why2Body: Short questions, concrete ideas, structured offer.
home.why3Body: Configuration and concept reach the manager with context intact.
